question: By 2027-09-30, will at least two of Intuit QuickBooks, Sage, and Xero document as generally available to US customers—not beta or private preview—an AI workflow that both proposes transaction categorizations and initiates or prepares reconciliation while retaining a human approval control?
resolution_rule: Resolve 1 only if qualifying dated public product documentation exists for at least two named providers by 23:59 America/New_York on the deadline; otherwise 0. Archived documentation must show general availability, both defined workflow functions, US availability, and human approval. Marketing intent without availability does not qualify.
resolution_source: Dated official product documentation from Intuit QuickBooks, Sage, and Xero, archived at resolution
reference_class: Major accounting-platform feature diffusion after two incumbents announce adjacent agent capabilities
assumptions: Named providers retain US product lines
disconfirmers: One or more providers withdraw agent workflows
Reconciliation remains advisory-only without workflow initiation
author: artemiosu

question: By 2027-09-30, will at least one of Intuit QuickBooks, Sage, or Xero publish a feature-specific retained-usage denominator for an accounting-agent workflow, covering at least two consecutive quarters or a stated retention window of at least 90 days?
resolution_rule: Resolve 1 only for a dated public filing, methodology note, or official metrics publication that identifies the eligible-user denominator, active/retained numerator, exact accounting-agent workflow, and two consecutive quarters or at least a 90-day window; generic AI survey results, customer quotes, availability, or revenue growth do not qualify.
resolution_source: Official issuer filing, investor publication, or methods-backed metrics page archived at resolution
reference_class: Feature-level retention disclosure by public vertical-software platforms
assumptions: At least one named provider measures the workflow internally
disconfirmers: Only aggregate AI sentiment is reported
No denominator or retention window is disclosed
author: artemiosu

question: Will a US Census BTOS collection period ending on or before 2027-06-30 report current AI use of at least 20.0% among firms with 0–4 employees under wording comparable to the late-2025 any-business-function question?
resolution_rule: Resolve 1 if an official Census BTOS size-class release for a collection period ending by the deadline reports a point estimate at or above 20.0% for current AI use among firms with 0–4 employees using comparable wording. Resolve 0 if all qualifying published periods remain below 20.0%. If Census removes the cohort or materially changes the question without a bridge, document as invalid outside binary scoring rather than forcing an outcome.
resolution_source: U.S. Census Bureau BTOS employment-size-class data and methodology archived at resolution
reference_class: Recent BTOS diffusion among the smallest US firms under revised wording
assumptions: Census continues publishing a comparable 0–4 employee cohort
author: artemiosu
